# Booster — AI-Native Service Agency

> Booster is an AI-native service agency based in Warsaw, Poland. We build autonomous AI infrastructure for complex B2B operations — CRM implementation, open-source ERP, custom B2B software, and AI automation. End-to-end solutions shipped in six weeks, not twelve months.

- Founded in 2025, Warsaw-based, serving clients worldwide
- Four-person engineering team with 10x velocity via AI-native tooling (Claude, n8n, Python)
- Certified CRM partners: Monday, ClickUp, Pipedrive, Tilio
- Open-source ERP deployment via Open Mercato — zero license fees, zero vendor lock-in
- Contact: hello@boosterai.pl
- Book a free 30-min consultation: https://cal.com/szymon-bazan-iahn2z

## Services

- [AI Automation Studio](https://boosterai.pl/practices/ai-automation): Process automations powered by Claude, n8n and Python. Document workflows, internal copilots, measurable ROI in 90 days.
- [End-to-end B2B Software](https://boosterai.pl/practices/b2b-software): Custom products built ground-up (React, Node, Python). Full stack, cloud-native, 100% your IP. Shipped in weeks, not months.
- [CRM Implementation & Automation](https://boosterai.pl/practices/crm-implementation): Boxed CRM stacks for Monday, ClickUp, Pipedrive, Tilio — configured, integrated, and automated for your sales motion.
- [Open-source ERP & CRM](https://boosterai.pl/practices/open-source-erp): Open Mercato deployed on your infrastructure — enterprise power with zero per-seat pricing and full code ownership.

## Case Studies

- [OOH Manager](https://boosterai.pl/#work): Automated 7 out of 9 sales steps for a media network with 40,000+ billboard locations. Proposal creation cut from 7 days to 30 minutes. Shipped in 6 weeks.
- [Legal Flow — Restructuring](https://boosterai.pl/#work): AI engine transforms 1-hour audio client interviews into fully structured legal drafts, saving hundreds of billable hours per case.
- [Municipal Application](https://boosterai.pl/#work): License-free, open-source B2G product line for Polish local governments, replacing expensive vendor lock-in with weeks-not-quarters deployment.
- [Kancelaria Jablonska — Office Ops](https://boosterai.pl/#work): n8n + Claude + Python automation pipelines to clean, deduplicate, and structure thousands of messy business records.

## Process

- [How We Work](https://boosterai.pl/#process): Four-stage delivery in six weeks — Map (strategic workshop and roadmap), Cleanse (data structuring and deduplication), Deploy (production-first from week three), Own (full code handover with zero lock-in).
